questions.question: Two Bézier segments share an endpoint, but the camera changes direction abruptly as it crosses the join. What should you adjust to remove the corner?
answers: Make the two handles equal in length
Move the camera at constant speed
Align the two handles across the join
Use more samples in the distance table

questions.question: A spline has segments numbered 0 and 1. At u = 1.4, which segment and local t should we evaluate?
answers: Segment 1 at t = 0.4
Segment 0 at t = 0.4
Segment 1 at t = 0.6
Segment 0 at t = 0.6

questions.question: Every frame, the camera adds rate × deltaTime to u. The joins are smooth, yet the camera still speeds up and slows down. Why?
answers: It slows down where the path bends
Frame time varies from frame to frame
Local t restarts at 0 in each segment
Equal steps in u cover unequal distances

questions.question: A curved path’s length is estimated by adding the straight lines between samples along the whole path. Measuring that same path with 4 lines instead of 32 makes each line longer. What happens to the estimated length?
answers: It gets shorter
It gets longer
It stays the same
Either way, depending on the bends
